.checkLoadConsensusPeaksArguments

Source: R/loadConsensusPeaks.R
dot-checkLoadConsensusPeaksArguments.Rd

Checks the arguments of loadConsensusPeaks and brings them to the form the rest of the function works with.

Usage

.checkLoadConsensusPeaksArguments(
  sampleSheet,
  groupBy,
  regionMode,
  unassignedSet,
  seed,
  weightMethod,
  calibrate,
  nPermutations,
  targetFDR,
  recentre,
  width,
  combinationMethod,
  replicateType,
  stringencyThreshold,
  weakThreshold,
  combinedThreshold,
  alpha,
  minSupport,
  minReplicates,
  minOverlap,
  minOverlapFraction,
  mergeMethod,
  maxConsensusWidth,
  verbose,
  ...
)
